hero.title: Discover the right jobs faster, with more clarity and better personal context.
hero.description: Hiring Radar brings the full job pool into one product surface, highlights what fits you, and improves matching as your profile gets stronger.
hero.pill1: See, filter and compare the full opportunity pool in one explorer.
hero.pill2: Use a matched-for-you layer without hiding the rest of the market.
hero.pill3: Switch smoothly between Turkish, English and German.
hero.panelSubtitle: Highlighted roles based on your profile
hero.matchLabel: High fit based on your profile

feature1.title: One unified jobs view
feature1.description: Jobs Explorer becomes the main product screen for search, filtering and comparison.

feature2.title: Profile completion as product logic
feature2.description: Expose missing profile fields and explain why better data improves matching quality.

feature3.title: Ready for international users
feature3.description: A multilingual foundation with theme support and a calmer premium UI language.

auth.loginProductBadge: A login surface that also sells the product
auth.loginHeadline: You are not just logging in; you are entering a focused workspace for better opportunity discovery.
auth.loginDescription: The page balances product messaging with the authentication flow. Theme stays in the top-right; value stays in the main narrative.
auth.loginSubtext: Use password login or request a magic link.
auth.signupBadge: Signup flow focused on user conversion
auth.signupHeadline: Create your profile, pass a light human check and start building stronger matches.
auth.signupDescription: Signup stays simple but trustworthy: basic details, human challenge, password creation and starter preferences.
auth.signupSubtext: In this phase the signup shell is ready. The API wiring comes next.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in

signal.title: Every opportunity in one place
signal.description: Users first see the full job market; matching remains an added intelligence layer.

clarity.title: Sharper information hierarchy
clarity.description: Search, theme, language and core actions stay together in one predictable header.

control.title: Settings like a real product
control.description: Profile, security, preferences and notifications run as separate routes.

multilingual.title: TR / EN / DE ready
multilingual.description: The product starts with multilingual support instead of treating it as a later add-on.

jobs.title: Jobs Explorer
jobs.description: This is the full market view. Search, filter, compare and still see what matches you best.
jobs.searchPlaceholder: Search jobs, companies, skills or cities...

matches.title: Jobs matched for you
matches.description: A focused list of roles that currently align with your profile signals.

saved.title: Saved jobs
saved.description: We will connect the personalized saved-jobs flow next. This phase delivers the route and UI shell.

completion.title: Profile completion
completion.description: The more complete your profile is, the better the matching quality we can deliver.

settings.pageDescription: Manage profile, security, preferences and notifications through route-based settings.

profile.title: Profile details
profile.description: Core identity, contact and education data belong here.

education.title: Education

security.title: Security
security.description: Password, magic-link and session security live here.

preferences.title: Matching preferences
preferences.description: Keywords, locations, job type and other profile signals come together here.
preferences.skillsHint: Separate values by commas or new lines.
